task_definition.title: PNv2 vertex-side attribute widening (BRepKind::Vertex + extract_vertices + per-op seeding)
task_definition.description:
PRD: docs/prds/v0_3/mesh-morphing-phase-2.md task α (PNv2-owned per portfolio approach E)

Extend PNv2's attribute table to vertices symmetrically with existing face/edge seeding. Today `BRepKind` at `crates/reify-types/src/geometry.rs:54-71` only has `Edge` / `Face`; `OcctKernel` lacks `extract_vertices`; per-op attribute populators don't seed vertex attributes. This blocks mesh-morph Stage-B vertex bijection and the Gmsh `NodeAttachment` producer.

Deliverables (per PRD §3.1):
- `BRepKind::Vertex` variant added to `crates/reify-types/src/geometry.rs:54-71`.
- `OcctKernel::extract_vertices(handle) -> Result<Vec<GeometryHandleId>, QueryError>` mirroring `extract_edges` / `extract_faces` at `crates/reify-kernel-occt/src/handle.rs:293-318` and the stub at `crates/reify-kernel-occt/src/stubs.rs:80-95`. Each vertex registered with `BRepKind::Vertex`.
- `Role::CornerVertex` variants per PRD §2 Q-MM2-1 table (box `CornerVertex { x_face: ±X, y_face: ±Y, z_face: ±Z }`; extrude/revolve/sweep/loft `CapCornerVertex { face: CapFace }`).
- Per-op attribute populators extended in `crates/reify-eval/src/topology_attribute_propagation.rs` (sweeps) and `crates/reify-eval/src/primitive_attribute_seed.rs` (primitives) to seed vertex attributes alongside face/edge.
- Wired through `engine_build.rs` realization-ops path symmetrically.
- Deterministic `local_index` ordering follows PNv2's centroid → normal → construction-order rule.
- Out of scope: Cone/Torus/Tube vertex seeding (deferred per parent PNv2 audit M-008); Manifold KernelAttributeHook vertex MeshGL walk (PNv2 M-018 stub).

User-observable signal (D-discipline per PRD §8 task α): new test `extract_vertices_and_attribute_seeding_box` in `crates/reify-eval/tests/topology_attribute_vertex_seeding.rs` asserts:
- `extract_vertices(box_handle).len() == 8`
- Each vertex carries a `TopologyAttribute` entry with `Role::CornerVertex` and stable `(feature_id, local_index)` across a `thickness`-param tick.

Gap register: resolves GR-023 / M-002 vertex-widening half (cross-PRD seam owned by PNv2 PRD per portfolio approach E). PNv2 PRD eventual re-decomposition will absorb this as `done` via same-PRD supersession.

Dependencies: NONE (foundation of the bundle).

Crates touched: reify-types, reify-kernel-occt, reify-eval.
